rule: Conservative review-scope flag; true does not assert readable text/OCR. Actual or individually plausible text/sign/traffic-signal/directional or functional safety symbol regions qualify, including incidental/unreadable. Ordinary geometry, objects, gestures and decorative nonlanguage graphics alone do not. Uncertain qualifying regions stay explicit ambiguous without transcription.
